name: Text extraction
description: Extract text between literal markers, collect matching lines and look up key=value entries.
author: Blockworked

block_defs.description: Returns text after the first literal start marker and before the next literal end marker. Case-sensitive and Unicode-aware. Empty or missing markers return empty text.
Returns all lines containing the literal needle, in order, joined with LF. Matching is case-sensitive. An empty needle includes every line. Normalizes CRLF and CR to LF.

Looks up the first matching key=value line. Trims keys and values; keys match exactly and case-sensitively. Preserves additional = signs in the value. Ignores blank keys, # comments and lines without =. Missing keys return empty text.

blocks.description: Extract text between literal markers, collect matching lines and look up key=value entries.
